chapter_title: Concerning the Alms, that [ ... ] life in the Chur
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


---


**
¶5:**
 What
 does the gathering
 of those
 being
 instruct
ed in
 truth
 resemble? It is like a
 well
-disposed natural mind in
 which the Lord
 impl
ants a living
 perception
 of good
. That
 living
 perception
 transforms every
 faculty
 and
 power of the natural mind, and it
 brings
 forth genuine
 works of charity. The
 Lord
 brings
 the
 in
most perception of celest
ial love into
 a
 state of peace, and He
 Himself rests within
 it —
 for
 the
 Divine
 dw
ells where
 love
 has
 taken
 root
 and
 
borne its
 works
.

---


**¶7:** In
 the same way,
 the
 interior
 spiritual essence that
 is now
 set
 within
 the
 state
 where
 good and evil are intermingled —
 it
 desires
 to be
 elevated and
 to enter the heav
enly society to
 which it
 belongs by
 its
 ruling
 love. But it perce
ives and
 understands that there
 is no passage
 open
 to it through
 any
 of the organized faculties of the internal
 or external mind, for
 these
 fac
ulties,
 still
 ruled
 by falsity and self-love,
 press
 upon
 it
 and
 const
rain it from every side. Indeed
, it has no passage except
 through Divine
 Love and Divine Wisdom themselves —
 the Lord
 as He sh
ines forth into
 the mind
 through celest
ial love and spiritual
 faith.
 These
 become
 the state
 of peace for
 the
 spiritual essence.
 And they become the
 opening
 through
 which the interior
 degree of the mind is
 unl
ocked, and
 the spiritual essence passes
 through
 them
 into
 the heaven
 of its own
 society
,
 the kingdom
 where
 those
 of
 its own
 love
 dwell.

---

**
¶8:** And
 further still
:
 even
 Divine
 Love and Divine Wisdom, as they
 appear within
 the fac
ulties of the spiritual mind, find
 no final rest
 among any
 created
 powers
 of the
 interior
 understanding
 —
 except
 in
 the Divine
 Itself
, which
 has
 been
 their
 origin
 and dwelling
 from
 et
ernity.


---

**¶9:**
 In
 this way the
 interior
 spiritual essence is purified of all fals
ities and evil affections through
 the
 process
 of regeneration. And
 the
 Lord
 grants
 it
 heav
enly peace, and opens
 the
 interior
 degree
 that
 admits
 it
 into
 the society
 of heaven
 to
 which it belongs.

---

**
¶10:** And
 it is so
 that the Divine
 Itself becomes the final reception
 for all
 love
 and wisdom that have
 flowed forth as
 if
 through
 celest
ial and
 spiritual light
 into
 the mind —
 and
 they
 come
 to rest in the
 Infinite
 from
 which they proceeded
,
 and the
 Divine
 gov
erns through
 them forever
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: What does the assembly of catechu[me]ns resemble? It is like good earth [that has been tilled and prepared] in which the gardener shall plant a good tree. [Beho]ld, [th]at good tree transforms the power and the [nature] of all earth, and it produces good fruit. [Th]at [gardener] sets at ease the tree of life, and he r[ests himself].

Likewise this [liv]ing sou[l] that today is set in mixture; for it wishes to [as]cend and go to the house of its people, but it kn[ows a]nd understands that it has no open door in all the powers of heaven and earth. For they are its oppression that [constrains and binds] it everywhere. Indeed, it has no open door except the sun and the moon themselves, the light-givers of the heavens [that pour forth their light upon it; and] they become the place of rest for it. And they become a door that opens for it [in] the coming forth, and (the soul) comes out through them to the country of the household of i[ts] people.
Again, further in, also the light-givers of the heavens have no place of rest amongst all the powers of heaven; except for the lan[d] of light, that has indeed been theirs for ever.
So, thus the living soul is purified of all afflictions; and they provide a rest for it, and open a door that opens to the house [of] its people.
Also, it is the case that the land of lig[ht] will become the final receiver for the light-givers of [the] heavens, and they will rest themselves therein and rule in it [for] ever.
